notes: Printed page 197: 'Details of returns not shown separately in Table XV, part i' (details of combined entries). Group rows (A. 28, D. 59, E. 79, F. 85, G. 91) are given as lang_is_total records with serial = Table XV serial; language records carry serial = the Table XV serial of their group and supp_no = the printed Supplement II number (1-42). Italic city rows (Dacca City, Howrah City, Calcutta suburbs) are sub-rows of the district above (area_path [Bengal, district]). SIKKIM rows have area_path ['Sikkim']. Checks: every ALL DISTRICTS total equals the sum of its district rows (excluding SIKKIM and italic city sub-rows); the group totals equal the sums of their languages' Bengal (non-Sikkim) figures, e.g. A. 28 = 69,896 = Bengal 'Others' (28) in Part A. Group G 91 = 352 also matches Part A serial 91. Group B/C have no entries on this page.
